summary: PRIMARY REGRESSION FROM ITER77 IS FIXED. Frontend-only retest (backend skipped per instructions). The path-independent restore block added in today.tsx right after the getTodaySession try/catch (~lines 3982-4002) correctly re-hydrates stored added exercises on cold start REGARDLESS of whether the plan API 404s or returns a session. Verified end-to-end for user_a (whose /api/plan/session/today returns 404 'Free training mode' — the exact case that broke iter77): (1) tapped '+ Add Exercise' at the bottom, added Back Squat from library — landed under a primary section; (2) opened the picker again, created custom TEST_QA_ColdRestart_78 with SECTION=Cooldown + TRACKS=Time(sec) — landed under the COOLDOWN section with a Sec unit dropdown + sec text field + LOG button; (3) full page reload — BOTH exercises re-rendered, console printed '[Today] Path-independent: restored 2 added exercises', localStorage today_added_exercises key intact; (4) navigated Today→Tools→Today — both still present exactly once; (5) second full page reload — restore still shows count=2 and DOM contains each name exactly once (dedup by id works); (6) 'Create New Exercise' still renders directly UNDER the search bar in the picker; (7) custom-exercise How-To opens the YouTube search fallback screen with a 'Search: <name>' button when no link was provided. Section order post-reload verified via text-index positions: PRIMARY block first, Back Squat present, then COOLDOWN header, then TEST_QA_ColdRestart_78 immediately below. No red screen, no new console errors introduced by the fix.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing deprecation warning still firing: 'Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages'. Not introduced by this iteration but should be migrated. Reference: any file importing expo-av.

Zero testID props on the interactive elements exercised in this test (Add Exercise button, Create New Exercise, section chips, tracks chips, Save & Use, exercise cards). All selectors relied on visible text — brittle for future regressions. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/today.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/ExercisePicker.tsx.

action_items: None for the tested regression — the fix is complete and stable across reload, in-app nav, and repeat reload paths.

Housekeeping (carried over from iter77, still open): (a) add testIDs to today.tsx + ExercisePicker.tsx interactive elements, (b) migrate expo-av → expo-audio + expo-video, (c) consider whether /api/plan/session/today should stop returning 404 for user_a while the client renders a program-mode session — the data-consistency mismatch is not user-visible now that restore is path-independent, but it's still a mismatch worth investigating.

The lingering TEST_QA_Cooldown_Stretch_77 from iter77 is still in user_a's user_exercises collection (visible in picker under YOUR CUSTOM EXERCISES). Non-disruptive. Now iter78 has also created TEST_QA_ColdRestart_78 which will similarly linger — safe to leave or manually clean via DELETE /api/user-exercises/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: today.tsx is now ~7055 lines. Splitting into hooks (useMountRestore, useAddedExercisesPersist, useTodayRestore) and section subcomponents would prevent the exact class of nesting bug that iter77 revealed. Every regression here is compounded by file size.

The addedExercisesRestored.current=true is now set unconditionally at :4002 — good. Confirm the equivalent flag is also set inside the same-day fast-path re-sync (~:3605-3619) to be belt-and-braces; the mount-restore already fires first so this is defensive-only.

The Path-independent restore uses setExercises(prev=>...) with an id-based Set for dedup — correct even if the inline restore at :3872 already ran, so the double-restore in the api-success path is idempotent.
Consider extracting a single ADDED_EXERCISES_KEY hook so the merge logic isn't duplicated in three places (inline restore + fast-path re-sync + path-independent restore).
seed_data_creation: One new custom exercise created via UI for user_a: TEST_QA_ColdRestart_78 (category=cooldown, prescriptionType=timed). Non-disruptive; can be left in place for future re-tests or cleaned via DELETE /api/user-exercises/{id}. iter77's TEST_QA_Cooldown_Stretch_77 is still present as well.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The cold-start regression for user_a on program-mode Today is confirmed fixed at today.tsx:3982-4002. If future work touches the mount/restore/persist trio, always retest with a user whose /api/plan/session/today returns 404 (user_a is perfect for this) — that is the exclusive path that gates the restore. Console must print '[Today] Path-independent: restored N added exercises' after each cold start for any today_added_exercises payload that matches today's date. localStorage today_added_exercises must survive across reloads even when the exercises array starts empty (persist effect at :3534 is guarded by addedExercisesRestored.current). Login token field: `token`. Backend URL env key: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. No testIDs exist yet — use text selectors and the picker's 'Search exercises…' placeholder input.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found this iteration. The iter77 root cause (restore nested inside `if (apiExs.length > 0)`) has been correctly addressed by moving the restore out of the api-success guard and setting the restored-flag unconditionally right after the API try/catch. Verified via console log '[Today] Path-independent: restored 2 added exercises' on every cold start, DOM re-render of both Back Squat and the custom cooldown exercise, and intact localStorage today_added_exercises across reloads.
